To access each route, you must enter the player ID and the match ID.
Restrictions have also been added so that the creator cannot leave the match; if they want to leave, they must cancel the match.

The route that controls joining a match is /api/match/join
The route that controls leaving a match is /api/match/leave

author: mistercrunch
body:
When using the "Group remaining as Others" feature with series limits, the generated SQL contained an unquoted literal in the GROUP BY clause, causing queries to fail.

Problem:
- SQL was generated with: ELSE Others END (unquoted)
- Should be: ELSE 'Others' END (quoted string literal)

Root cause:
1. Used sa.literal_column("Others") which treats "Others" as a column name
2. make_sqla_column_compatible interfered with proper literal quoting in GROUP BY

Solution:
1. Changed to sa.literal("Others") for proper string literal handling
2. Removed make_sqla_column_compatible from GROUP BY expressions since:
   - GROUP BY doesn't need aliases/labels
   - The labeling was interfering with SQLAlchemy's literal compilation

Related to #34308 which introduced the "Group remaining as Others" feature.

body:
Fixed the PLAY AGAIN functionality in both Music Memory and MEMOMU Memory game modes to properly reset all state variables and start fresh rounds immediately without splash screens or remnants from previous games.

## Problem
The PLAY AGAIN button had several issues:
- **Splash screen conflicts**: Reset functions would set splash to `true`, then PLAY AGAIN would override to `false`, causing timing issues
- **Incomplete state reset**: Game variables weren't fully reinitialized as in a fresh start
- **Missing redraw calls**: New boards weren't immediately visible after reset
- **Inconsistent behavior**: PLAY AGAIN didn't behave exactly like pressing START/GO for the first time

## Solution
1. **Modified reset functions** to accept an optional `showSplash` parameter (defaults to `true` for backward compatibility):
   - `startMusicMemoryGame(showSplash = true)`
   - `startMemoryGameMemomu(showSplash = true)`

2. **Updated PLAY AGAIN logic** to call reset functions with `showSplash = false` and ensure immediate game start:
   ```javascript
   // Music Memory PLAY AGAIN
   startMusicMemoryGame(false); // No splash
   startMemoryPhase(); // Start immediately
   drawMusicMemory(); // Redraw new board
   
   // MEMOMU Memory PLAY AGAIN  
   startMemoryGameMemomu(false); // No splash
   setTimeout(runMemoryMemomuFlashSequence, 900); // Start flash sequence
   drawMemoryGameMemomu(); // Redraw new board
   ```

3. **Consolidated duplicate logic** by updating `restartCurrentGame()` to use the same approach for consistency

## Testing Results
✅ **PLAY AGAIN (Fixed)**:
- Music Memory: No splash screen, immediate start
- MEMOMU Memory: No splash/GO screen, immediate start  

✅ **Normal Game Start (Preserved)**:
- Both modes still show splash screens as expected when starting normally

✅ **Complete State Reset**:
- Fresh board grids with new images/sequences
- Scores reset to 0, rounds reset to 1
- All game phases properly reinitialized
- Immediate visual update with proper redraw

The PLAY AGAIN functionality now works exactly as specified: **fresh rounds start immediately with no splash screens, just like pressing START/GO for the first time**.

<screenshot>
![Game showing main menu](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/4c3f66f1-6db3-4099-99da-2d36f7428bc0)
</screenshot>

<!-- START COPILOT CODING AGENT SUFFIX -->

*This pull request was created as a result of the following prompt from Copilot chat.*
> Fix the PLAY AGAIN logic in both MEMOMU Memory and Music Memory modes so that after clicking PLAY AGAIN, the board and all state variables (game grid, memory sequence, splash overlays, etc.) are fully reset, and a fresh round starts immediately (no remnants of the previous board and no splash unless required).
> 
> Key steps:
> - After clicking PLAY AGAIN, fully reinitialize all game state and grid variables as in a fresh round (just like pressing GO or START for the first time).
> - Ensure splash overlays (memomuGame.showSplash, musicMem.showRoundSplash, etc.) are set to false after PLAY AGAIN, unless a splash is explicitly required.
> - Invoke the appropriate redraw function at the end of the reset to guarantee the new board is visible right away.
> - Remove any redundant or duplicate PLAY AGAIN handlers, and make sure the reset logic is only in one place per mode.
> - Test for both MEMOMU Memory and Music Memory modes: No old board, no black screens, and no stuck splash after PLAY AGAIN.

#### Problem solved by the commit
This PR corrects the hardcoding of recipe and profile JSON file names in xrt-smi tests.
Today, the windows driver installation through INF doesn't allow multiple files with the same name which causes integration of these tests to windows driver painful since the file needs to be different for different devices (phx, strx, npu3 etc).

#### Bug / issue (if any) fixed, which PR introduced the bug, how it was discovered
None

#### How problem was solved, alternative solutions (if any) and why they were rejected
This PR adds queries for each runner artifacts from driver and allows the driver to be flexible on what it wants to name these files. Now, the driver can store these files with _phx, _stx appended to the name and return device specific runner artifacts, instead of the file name being hard-coded to the test itself.

#### Risks (if any) associated the changes in the commit
NA

#### What has been tested and how, request additional testing if necessary
Tested on strx and phx platforms.

NA

<!--

Issue Number: Close #18458

<!--
You could use "commit message" code block to add more description to the final commit message.
For more info, check https://github.com/tikv/tikv/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#format-of-the-commit-message.
-->
What's Changed:

```commit-message
Remove a learner if it is in unsafe recovery demotion list.

If a TiFlash learner is the most up-to-date peer during unsafe recovery, it will be tombstoned, and another
peer in the group will be forced as a leader. If we don't remove TiFlash learner from leader's Raft group's
member list, the learner will be considered as "down" thus need to be replaced. However, if there is only
one TiFlash node, this replacement will stuck since PD has 0 candidate node. To resolve this, we simply need
to remove the learner from the membership list.
```
